tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: One Sparkflights fare by the numeric id from search_deals: its itinerary, the price text of its fare page, its outbound and return flights, the date pairs its fare page lists with their prices, and its url, route_url and feed_url. A fare Sparkflights no longer lists returns an error naming its route

tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Search the flight fares Sparkflights has found, ranked by cost per mile against each market's limit. Each deal shows when its price was last checked, and prices can change after that; an empty result means Sparkflights has no fare that matches, not that no flights exist. Each deal has the price text

tools.name: watch_route
tools.description: Saves a fare watch for a route, so the person hears about new and cheaper fares on it by email and browser notification. Use it when they ask to watch a route, or to be told, alerted or notified when fares on it appear or drop. When they are signed in it saves the watch to their Sparkflights account

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "search" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_deal, search_deals · Public sink: watch_route · Destructive: watch_route.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_deal, search_deals · Public sink: watch_route · Destructive: watch_route

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "get_deal" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
